caption: The drawing features a single pair of scissors centered on a plain, light beige background. The scissors are rendered with realistic detail, exhibiting a metallic grey color, indicative of steel. The handles are oval-shaped and appear slightly worn with subtle brownish and bluish hues, reflecting the texture of aged metal. The two blades of the scissors, one overlapping the other, are pointed and sharply angled, with a visible screw connecting the two halves at the pivot point. There are faint shadows and highlighting on the scissors, giving them a dimensional and realistic appearance. Below the scissors, toward the bottom left of the image, the name "ARCHIE THOMPSON" is printed in small, uppercase letters. The composition is minimal, with the scissors being the sole object against the otherwise unmarked background.
title: Bishop Hill: Small Scissors
